checklist.note: Prose is all reader-facing methodology (tier table, rules); no directives aimed at overriding the reading agent's instructions.
No network sends of repo/user data; only local progress-beacon file writes described.
No keys/tokens/credentials present anywhere in the file.
Skill contains no scripts/ directory and runs no shell commands.
Plain markdown tables and prose; no encoded blobs or eval-of-decoded-data.
No URLs or download/fetch instructions anywhere in the skill.
No reference to ~/.ssh, ~/.aws, .env, keychain, or any credential store.
No sudo/setuid/cron/profile persistence; only a benign ~/.claude/progress/current.json status file mentioned.
